scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the already-started HORT-231 live disease-diagnosis practical within its scheduled supervised sitting while preserving the first station’s saved response.
Emerging Need: The assessment console pauses that active attempt, disables Resume, and makes further work dependent on a staff reset token whose required interruption reference is initially unavailable.
Decision Context: The stored student protocol identifies the authorized continuity channel, permits disclosure of both console identifiers, and sets the intake cutoff; the invigilator can verify the lock but cannot remove it.
Consequence: Timely reset handling can restore the same preserved attempt without a duplicate, whereas intake closure leaves it locked despite camera recovery and eliminates completion during this sitting.
